title: Geometry-Induced Hodge Stars on Rips and Dowker--Rips Complexes
summary: The Vietoris--Rips complex $\mathrm{VR}_ε(X)$, the Dowker complex $\mathrm{D}_R(X,Y)$, and its flagified Dowker--Rips variant $\mathrm{DR}_R(X,Y)=\mathrm{F}(\mathrm{D}_R(X,Y))$ are simplicial complexes constructed from metric data or witness relations. They are useful in topological data analysis because they encode topology through combinatorial data derived from pairwise information, but at a fixed scale they retain little of the underlying geometry.
